_meta.title: Crimes a visitor could suffer, per district of India (NCRB 2017-2022)

sources.crime: NCRB 'Crime in India', district-wise IPC crimes, via India Data Portal (https://ckandev.indiadataportal.com/dataset/crime-statistics)
sources.population: Census of India 2011, Primary Census Abstract, via India Data Portal (dataset census-pca-demography)

_meta.method: Per district: mean yearly count of the listed IPC heads across all police units reporting in that district, divided by its Census 2011 population (per lakh). Districts created after 2011 have no census figure and use their state's rate (rate_basis='state'). crime_index = percentile rank of rate_per_lakh among all districts (0 = lowest, 100 = highest).
caveats: Rates use 2011 population, so they are somewhat overstated where population has grown since; the percentile index is much less affected than the raw rate.
When a district was split after 2011, the parent's 2011 population still covers the split-off area, so the parent's rate is understated.
Recorded crime depends on reporting; low numbers can mean under-reporting.
Crimes against all residents, not only tourists: no district-level series of crimes against foreigners or tourists is published.
